controls.tooltip: Specifies the entry number from the VAT Entry table.

controls.name: Posting Date
controls.tooltip: Specifies the GST purchase entry's posting date.

controls.name: Document No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the document number on the GST purchase entry.

controls.name: Document Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the document type that the GST purchase entry belongs to.

controls.name: Document Line No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the line that the GST purchase entry belongs to.

controls.name: Document Line Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the type of the line that the entry belongs to.

controls.name: Vendor No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the vendor account linked to the GST purchase entry.

controls.name: Vendor Name
controls.tooltip: Specifies the name of the vendor account that the GST purchase entry is linked to.

controls.name: Document Line Description
controls.tooltip: Specifies a description of the item or G/L account that is associated with the fixed asset number.

controls.name: VAT Bus. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the VAT business posting group code that was used when the entry was posted.

controls.name: VAT Prod. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the VAT product posting group code that was used when the entry was posted.

controls.name: GSTPercentage
controls.caption: GST %
controls.tooltip: Specifies the relevant GST rate for the particular combination of GST business posting group and GST product posting group.

controls.name: GST Entry Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the type of the GST entry.

controls.name: GST Base
controls.tooltip: Specifies the amount that the GST amount (the amount shown in the Amount field) is calculated from.

controls.name: Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the amount of the GST entry in LCY.

controls.name: GSTTotalAmount
controls.caption: Total Purchase
controls.tooltip: Specifies the sum of the values in the GST Base and Amount fields on the GST purchase entry line.
